requirements.title: Company registered in the ROW Management System
requirements.detail: The facility owner must be registered with the City before a permit can be submitted, and the application goes in through the online system.

requirements.title: Permit application signed by the facility owner
requirements.detail: Written application on the director's form, signed by the owner of the facility.

source.label: Dallas City Code, Ch. 43, Art. VIII, permit section

requirements.title: List of every contractor and subcontractor
requirements.detail: No contractor or subcontractor may work in the right-of-way unless named on the permit for that project.

requirements.title: Submit at least 3 business days before construction
requirements.detail: Standard projects need three business days. A project the City treats as major needs enough lead for 30 business days of review.

source.label: Dallas City Code, Ch. 43, Art. VIII, permit section

requirements.title: Underground facility statement
requirements.detail: Statement that available plans for City and other underground utilities were collected, the design avoids apparent conflicts, and locations will be field-verified.

source.label: Dallas City Code, Ch. 43, Art. VIII, permit section

requirements.title: Construction plans, 11x17, plan view at 1" = 40' or larger
requirements.detail: Show horizontal and vertical alignment. Each sheet carries the project number, lettering at least 1/8" high, and a note to verify underground utilities 100 ft before crossings and where running parallel within 5 ft. Engineer's seal where state law requires one.

source.label: Dallas City Code, Ch. 43, Art. VIII, permit section

requirements.title: Profile views at 1" = 6' or larger
requirements.detail: Required for certain major projects: central business district, street intersections, or facility crossings.

source.label: Dallas City Code, Ch. 43, Art. VIII, permit section

requirements.title: Traffic control plan for each phase of work
requirements.detail: Detailed drawings for vehicle and pedestrian traffic in every phase, including detours and crosswalk closures. The City must approve it before work starts. A separate traffic control permit applies when a lane, sidewalk or alley is blocked.

source.label: Dallas City Code, Ch. 43, Art. VIII, permit section

requirements.title: Traffic control plan waiver may apply
requirements.detail: On local residential streets, franchise utilities may be able to use the City's waiver form in place of a formal plan. Work must still follow the Traffic Barricade Manual and TMUTCD.

source.label: Dallas Temporary Traffic Control Approval Waiver

requirements.title: Pre-construction notice completed and affirmed
requirements.detail: The application must affirm that pre-construction notice requirements were met.

source.label: Dallas City Code, Ch. 43, Art. VIII, permit section

requirements.title: Performance bond, letter of credit or cash deposit
requirements.detail: Required before the permit issues for pavement excavation or boring that installs a new facility or significantly relocates one. Amount is at least 100% of the City's estimate of repair cost. Localized service lines and repairs are exempt.

requirements.title: Boring conditions on site
requirements.detail: Keep current plans at the site, pothole water mains where required, and be able to give the bore head location on request.

source.label: Dallas City Code, Ch. 43, Art. VIII, permit section

requirements.title: Start within 60 calendar days of issuance
requirements.detail: The permit is void if construction has not begun. Ask for an extension before it expires.

source.label: Dallas City Code, Ch. 43, Art. VIII, permit section

requirements.title: Temporary pavement repairs out within 14 calendar days
requirements.detail: Temporary repairs may not stay in the right-of-way longer without an extension granted before the limit runs out.

source.label: Dallas City Code, Ch. 43, Art. VIII, permit section

requirements.title: Emergency work: notify the director immediately
requirements.detail: Emergency work may begin without the standard lead time, with immediate notice that states the reasons.

source.label: Dallas City Code, Ch. 43, Art. VIII, permit section
